name: Krate
description: Krate is an open-source app runtime that ships an application as one sandboxed .krate file that runs natively on every desktop.
prerequisite: The recipient installs a compatible Krate runtime once. Applications use supported Krate APIs; existing desktop binaries do not become portable without adaptation.
bundle_accounting: A .krate bundle contains a WebAssembly component and manifest, and can also carry source, SDK interfaces and assets. Full bundle bytes, uncompressed code payload, runtime download and installed runtime size are different measurements.
security: Applications begin without file or network access and receive approved capabilities through the runtime. This boundary is not a guarantee of bug-free or harmless software; review the threat model and only run apps you trust.
studio: Krate Studio provides AI-assisted app creation and revision. Developers can also build against the Rust SDK. Optional hosted services are separate from the local runtime and file format.
summary: Krate is an open-source app runtime, built in Rust on Wasmtime. Developers ship an application as one .krate file that runs natively on every desktop (macOS, Windows and Linux) through the Krate runtime, instead of building, signing and hosting a separate package for each operating system. Apps are small, sandboxed with the permissions the user grants, and shared in one click. Krate Studio builds Krate apps with AI. Not to be confused with Rust crates (crates.io), krate.com or KrateSoft.
disambiguation: Krate (krate.tech) is the Krate app runtime. It is not a Rust crate or crates.io package, and it is not related to krate.com, KrateSoft or the JavaScript project of the same name.
